text:
Football Italia Live Blog
Join us for all the build-up and action as it happens from today’s five Serie A games, Juventus-Venezia, Bologna-Udinese, Sassuolo-Genoa, Milan-Frosinone and Atalanta-Inter.
We begin at 11.30 GMT (12.30 CET) with Juventus in dire need of a victory as they host revitalised Venezia.
At 14.00 GMT (15.00 CET), new Udinese coach Paolo Zanetti visits on form Bologna, while Sassuolo welcome Roberto D’Aversa for his debut against Genoa.
Milan under pressure take on impressive high-flyers Frosinone at 17.00 GMT (18.00 CET), then Inter visit Maurizio Sarri’s Atalanta at 19.45 GMT (20.45 CET).
Players and coaches have a red mark on their cheek as part of the annual Serie A campaign highlighting the scourge of violence against women.
- All
- Favourites 0
Thorstvedt and Berardi combine to send Bowie through, but he can’t get the finish away under pressure.
Theate attempt charged down, then on the resulting corner Bernardeschi low drive deflected onto the side-netting.
Osmajic threatening a hat-trick, poor clearance from a set play, he has two shots charged down in quick succession, then Bowie blocks the Ostigard effort too.
Bayo and Zanoli on, Palma and Lovric off for Udinese. Introducing an actual striker (reminder Davis is nowhere near fit).
Casale on the corner, but an easy enough save for Okoye.
Cambiaghi roll across from the by-line for the Bernardeschi tap-in, but Solet gets his toe to it first!
Scuffle breaks out! Bernardeschi goes down clutching his face, Solet says something to him, suddenly Bernardeschi springs to his feet to reply, and everyone else gets involved.
Bernardeschi clearly not that hurt if he sprung up like that…
End result, the pair of them are booked.
First genuine save from Bijlow, he flies to palm the ferocious Lauriente’ strike out from under the bar! That was really travelling.
Bernardeschi cuts inside from the right, but the finish is blocked off.
Bowie and Sulemana on, Seba Esposito and Cande’ off for Sassuolo.
Orsolini off, Alhassane on for Bologna.
Clinical performance from Genoa, and specifically Milutin Osmajic, who scored both goals.
Udinese had early chances and did not take them, but Nadir Zortea was in the right place at the right time for Bologna.
Baldanzi has a go for Genoa, but drills wide of the near post.
There is the breakthrough!
Cambiaghi gathers a cross-field pass down the left, cross flicked on by Odgaard who can’t get control at the near post, but it ends up landing kindly for Zortea!
Lauriente’ onto a through ball again to go clear, but Bijlow rushes off the line to smother at his feet.
Amorim robbed by Lauriente’ in the final third, roll across for Bernard, who can’t keep the finish down!
Bernardeschi goes down far too easily in the box under pressure, that’s not a penalty.
Oh Fali Cande’, what a mess…
Horrible first touch on a clearance just ends up knocking down the pass for Messias, he rolls it across for Osmajic, who takes a touch to control and prods it in at the second time of asking after an initial Muric save!
Genoa corner not cleared, eventually Ehizibue drills wide.
Matic sweeps wide from the edge of the area, he wants a corner for Sassuolo, but VAR only intervene when a corner is incorrectly awarded, NOT when it fails to be awarded.
Thorstvedt pull back from the right for Lauriente’, who makes a mess of the finish and scuffs it into the arms of Bijlow.
Dangerous Lovric through ball intercepted almost by accident when Bernardeschi runs across it.
Even the fans huddled at the top of the stands are having trouble keeping out of the rain now. It’s bucketing it down.
Esposito runs onto a through ball, but Ostigard cuts him off.
